read.description: Read ABAP object metadata for a package, transport request, or explicit object list. Returns object headers (name, type, package, responsible) without source code.

scope.description: Package name (e.g. ZMY_PACKAGE), transport request (e.g. DEVK00123456), or comma-separated object list.

readcontent.description: Read the full ABAP source code of a single object identified by name and type. Returns the source lines as text.

type.description: ABAP object type (e.g. CLAS, PROG, FUGR, ENHO).

mock_response.name: ZCL_ORDER_ENRICH
mock_response.source:
CLASS zcl_order_enrich DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS enrich IMPORTING iv_order TYPE vbeln.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_enrich IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enrich.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM vbak INTO @DATA(ls_order) WHERE vbeln = @iv_order.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
